name: Xiamen Changelight Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Changelight Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sales of compound semiconductor optoelectronic products in China and internationally. The company offers LED chips, epitaxial wafers, gallium arsenide solar cells, LEDs/micro-LEDs, and VCSEL products for use in digital, matrix, display, traffic and black lights, lamps, indicators, and other fields. Xiamen Changelight Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
